summary: BioXcel Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing its thirteenth amendment to the 2022 credit agreement with Oaktree Fund Administration LLC as agent. The amendment extends to August 28, 2026 (from August 21) the deadline for the company to enter definitive agreements to repay all obligations under the credit facility or execute an alternative capital solutions transaction acceptable to lenders. This indicates financial distress and ongoing restructuring negotiations. No specific deal terms were disclosed. What to watch: potential repayment source, equity dilution, or debt-for-equity exchange, and lender approval dynamics.
